title: LegoEnv: Self-Evolving Agentic Environments via Modular Recombination
abstract: arXiv:2611.01834v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet existing environments are designed for specific tasks and fail to generalize to new ones. Recent methods automate environment construction with LLMs. However, they generate each environment from scratch, neither reusing parts shared across environments nor carrying a fix from one environment to the rest. To address this, we propose a new paradigm of evolving environment atoms, which composes environments from reusable atoms (intent, rule, data and server) and evolves the atoms when an environment fails to give reliable feedback (e.g., an application lacks a tool the task requires). To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce LegoEnv, which builds 5,465 verified environments over 223 applications, and one round of evolution raises the share of solvable environments from 71.6% to 88.3%. translated_title: LegoEnv：通过模块化重组实现自我进化的智能体环境
translated_abstract: LLM智能体通过与环境的交互来学习，然而现有的环境是为特定任务设计的，难以泛化到新任务。近期的方法开始利用LLM自动化构建环境，但它们都是从零开始生成每个环境，既不复用跨环境共享的部分，也无法将某个环境中发现的修复传递到其他环境。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种“进化环境原子”的新范式，该范式由可复用的原子（意图、规则、数据与服务器）组合而成环境，并在某个环境无法给出可靠反馈时（例如，应用缺少任务所需的工具）对这些原子进行进化。为实例化这一范式，我们提出了LegoEnv，它在223个应用上构建了5,465个经过验证的环境，一轮进化即将可解环境的比例从71.6%提升至88.3%。在AutomationBench上，基于这些环境进行SFT使Qwen3.6-27B的性能从16.0%提升至32.0%，而使用它们的RL……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: LegoEnv提出了一种将环境由可复用原子（意图、规则、数据、服务器）组合构建、并在环境反馈不可靠时自我进化这些原子的新范式，构建了5,465个经过验证的环境，将可解环境比例从71.6%提升至88.3%，并显著提升了智能体的SFT与RL训练效果。
en_tdlr: LegoEnv proposes a self-evolving paradigm that composes agent environments from reusable atoms (intent, rule, data, and server) and evolves these atoms when environments fail to provide reliable feedback, yielding 5,465 verified environments that raise the solvable-environment share from 71.6% to 88.3% and substantially boost SFT and RL performance of LLM agents.
